<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spell Protection Array](/Feats.aspx?ID=5031) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=11" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Wizard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=735" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 202

</column>

---

You inscribe a circle of arcane runes that dampen enemies’ magic. You create a glowing magic circle in a 5-foot burst within 30 feet. Creatures in the circle gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic. The circle lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain it, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.
name: Spell Protection Array
